snp2.1:1.1: II. CŪLAVAGGA. Ratanasutta. Yānīdha bhūtāni samāgatāmi bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, sabbe va bhūtā sumanā bhavantu, atho pi sakkacca suṇantu bhāsitaṃ. || ||
snp2.1:2.1: Tasmā hi bhūtā misāmetha sabbe, mettaṃ karotha mānusiyā pajāya, divā ca ratto ca haranti ye baliṃ, tasmā hi ne rakkhatha appamattā. || ||
snp2.1:3.1: Yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ panītaṃ, na no samaṃ atthi Tathāgatena, -- idam pi Buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:4.1: Khayaṃ virāgaṃ amataṃ paṇītaṃ yad ajjhagā Sakyamunī samāhito, na tena dhammena sam' atthi kiñci, -- idam pi Dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:5.1: Yam buddhaseṭṭho parivaṇṇayī suciṃ samādhim ānantarikañ ñam āhu,| samādhinā tena samo na vijjati, -- idam pi Dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:6.1: Ye puggalā aṭṭha satam pasatthā, cattāri etāni yugāni honti, te dakkhiṇeyyā Sugatassa sāvakā, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ panītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:7.1: Ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena nikkāmino Gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:8.1: Yath' indakhīlo paṭhaviṃ sito siyā catubbhi vātehi asampakampiyo, tathūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi yo ariyasaccāni avecca passati, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītāṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:9.1: Ye ariyasaccāni vibhāvayanti gambhīrapaññena sudesitāni, kiñcāpi te honti bhusappamattā, na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ ādiyanti, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:10.1: Sahā v' assa dassanasampadāya tayas su dhammā jahitā bhavanti:| sakkāyadiṭṭhi vicikicchitañ ca sīlabbataṃ vā pi yad atthi kiñci,
snp2.1:11.1: catūh' apāyehi ca vippamutto cha cābhiṭhānāni abhabbo kātuṃ, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:12.1: Kiñcāpi so kammaṃ karoti pāpakaṃ kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabbo so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:13.1: Vanappagumbe yathā phussitagge gimhāna māse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tathūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃhitāya, -- idam pi Buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:14.1: Varo varaññū varado varāharo anuttaro dhammavaraṃ adesayi, -- idam pi Buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:15.1: ‘Khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ, navaṃ n' atthi sambhavaṃ,' virattacittā āyatike bhavasmiṃ te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā| nibbanti dhīrā yathāyam padīpo, -- idam pi Saṃghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:16.1: Yānīdha bhūtāni samāgatāni bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, tathāgataṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ Buddhaṃ namassāma, suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:17.1: Yānīdha bhūtāni samāgatāmi bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, tathāgataṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ Dhammaṃ namassāma, suvatthi hotu. || ||
snp2.1:18.1: Yānīdha bhūtāni samāgatāni bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, tathāgataṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ Saṃghaṃ namassāma, suvatthi hotū ti || || RATANASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
